description.value:
Frequency once per day

Effect You touch an adjacent plant, causing it to grow rapidly and flower. Petals and spores fill the air around you, causing you to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Concealed] until the start of your next turn. As the nature of this effect still leaves your location obvious, you can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.
